THE_CASH_PAY_CARVE_OUT_LOCATED_AFFIRMATI.located_claim: Patients must either be uninsured or have insurance (either commercial or government-funded), but decide to self-pay.
THE_CASH_PAY_CARVE_OUT_LOCATED_AFFIRMATI.reading: This is AFFIRMATIVE INCLUSION of government-funded-insurance holders in the NovoCare Pharmacy cash/self-pay channel, provided they forgo insurance. It is structurally different from an exclusion list, which makes it less likely to be a summarizer conflation - but it is still NOT CONFIRMED.
THE_CASH_PAY_CARVE_OUT_LOCATED_AFFIRMATI.supporting_located_language: If you have Medicare, Medicare Part D, a Medicare Advantage Prescription drug plan, or any other state or federal health insurance plan, you agree to the following: You will not ask your insurance to pay you back for the money that you self-paid for your medication using this offer. Additionally, you will not attempt to count the cost of this medicine toward your insurance deductible or out-of-pocket limit.
THE_CASH_PAY_CARVE_OUT_LOCATED_AFFIRMATI.why_this_language_is_significant: The terms address Medicare holders DIRECTLY and impose conditions on them rather than barring them. A document that barred them would have no reason to spell out what they must agree to.
